name: Purple Ripple Pulse Avatar

description.zh: 深色背景上一枚正圆头像，内部由多层同心圆环叠成，从中心亮紫向外逐渐变暗，边缘带柔和紫色光晕；正中是白色双斜块标志，整体像水波扩散的发光徽章。
description.en: A perfectly circular avatar on a dark backdrop, built from concentric rings that fade from bright violet at the centre to deeper purple outward, with a soft violet glow bleeding past the edge. A white double-parallelogram mark sits at the centre, giving it the feel of a glowing ripple badge.

reconstructionPrompt: A circular avatar on a near-black background, formed by several concentric rings of purple that brighten toward the centre and fade outward, with a soft violet glow spilling beyond the circle. A white double-parallelogram glyph sits dead centre. On hover the rings light up and the glow grows; a later frame shows the rings expanding outward as a ripple pulse.
